notes: No human persons are identifiable in the colophon. 'śrīśākyamuṇibhattārakasya' refers to the Buddha. The subsequent phrase 'oṃ namā śrīśākyamu(ni) .. na .. ājñādayaṃkara' appears to be a corrupt invocation or prayer rather than a personal name. The tithi 'naniyāṃ' is likely corrupt for 'navamyāṃ'.
